content.comment_body: Hello. The example from this post works well, but I have an issue: my alarms are shown twice in the alarm view—once when the NQ output turns on and again when it turns off. Is there a way to have alarms triggered only when NQ is 'on'? ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Split from [company_name] [product_name] - [product_name] HMI, alarm tags.

analysis.insight_summary: The user notes that alarms are activated both when the output (NQ) switches on and off, causing duplicate entries in the alarm view. This results in confusion and excess alarm notifications, highlighting a potential challenge with the alarm logic setup in the [company_name] system.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants alarms to appear only when the NQ output is activated, not when it deactivates, to prevent duplicate and unnecessary alerts.
